name: Sun-Dried Bombil (Bombil)
description: Fresh coastal prawns naturally sun-dried on clean coastal sands. Head & tail sorted, high in protein, zero chemical preservatives or coloring. Ideal for roasting, stir-fries, and spicy gravies.
ingredients: Wild caught sea prawns, natural sea salt.

name: Konkan Crispy Bombay Duck (Cleaned Sukha Bombil)
description: Authentic coastal Maharashtra Bombay Duck. Gutted, thoroughly washed in sea water, and sun-dried on bamboo scaffolds. Fries up extraordinarily crunchy and aromatic.
ingredients: Fresh Bombay Duck (Harpadon nehereus), natural sea salt.

name: Silver Anchovies (Nethili Karuvadu / Sukha Koli)
description: Small, tender silver-line anchovies sun-cured naturally. Prized in Chettinad and Kerala cuisines for fiery Karuvadu curry and quick tawa pan fry with onion & green chillies.

name: Artisanal Spicy Prawn Pickle (Goan / Kerala Style Jhinga Achaar)
description: Succulent prawns crisp-fried in cold-pressed gingelly oil, simmered in a fiery roasted masala paste, garlic flakes, and natural coconut vinegar. A heavenly match with hot rice.
ingredients: Fresh Sea Prawns, Gingelly Oil, Garlic, Ginger, Kashmiri Chilli, Fenugreek, Mustard, Natural Coconut Vinegar, Salt.

name: Royal Shahi Garam Masala (Stone-Ground 16 Whole Spices)
description: Slow-roasted mace, green & black cardamom, dagad phool, star anise, and cloves ground slowly to retain natural volatile essential oils. Imparts deep royal aroma to curries and biryanis.
ingredients: Coriander, Cumin, Black Cardamom, Green Cardamom, Cinnamon, Cloves, Mace, Nutmeg, Star Anise, Bay Leaves, Stone Flower.

name: Pure Salem Lakadong Turmeric Powder (Curcumin > 7%)
description: Organically grown high-curcumin turmeric roots sun-dried and slowly pulverized. Gives a vibrant golden hue, earthy aroma, and powerful anti-inflammatory benefits.
ingredients: 100% Pure Lakadong / Salem Natural Turmeric Rhizomes.

name: Coastal Fish Fry & Curry Roast Masala
description: Authentic coastal blend with Byadgi chillies, coriander, fennel, black pepper, and roasted garlic. Makes restaurant-grade crispy fish rava fry and rich seafood curries.
ingredients: Byadgi Chilli, Guntur Chilli, Coriander, Cumin, Mustard, Fennel, Black Pepper, Garlic powder, Triphala.

name: Pampore Grade-A Kashmiri Mongra Saffron (Kesar)
description: Hand-picked pure deep crimson stigmas of saffron flowers from Pampore, Kashmir. Regal aroma and radiant golden tint for biryani, kheer, and badam milk.

name: Grandma's Sun-Dried Mango Pickle (Khatta-Teekha Aam Achaar)
description: Hand-cut raw Ramkela mangoes marinated in cold-pressed mustard oil, fenugreek, nigella seeds, and sun-matured for 21 days in traditional earthen barnis.
ingredients: Raw Mango, Kachi Ghani Mustard Oil, Fenugreek, Fennel, Kalonji, Red Chilli, Rock Salt, Turmeric, Asafoetida (Hing).

name: Banarasi Stuffed Red Chilli Pickle (Bharwa Lal Mirch)
description: Plump winter red chillies hand-stuffed with a roasted 12-spice masala blend and aged in pure virgin mustard oil.
ingredients: Fresh Red Chillies, Mustard Seeds, Dry Mango Powder (Amchur), Saunf, Ajwain, Black Salt, Mustard Oil.

name: Desi Lahsun Teekha Achaar (Spicy Garlic & Mustard Pickle)
description: Peeled country garlic pods tempered with crushed yellow mustard seeds, curry leaves, and spicy red flakes. Pairs heavenly with parathas and dal chawal.
ingredients: Desi Garlic, Mustard Seeds, Cold-Pressed Mustard Oil, Fenugreek, Red Chilli, Turmeric, Salt.

name: Sweet & Sour Lemon Pickle (Oil-Free Nimbu Khatta Meetha)
description: Thin-skinned Kagzi lemons slowly aged under natural sunlight with organic jaggery, black cumin, and rock salt. 100% oil-free and aids healthy digestion.
ingredients: Kagzi Lemons, Organic Desi Gur (Jaggery), Rock Salt, Black Pepper, Cumin, Hing.
